reviews.title: AS3 Flash Player backlog (Loader, Worker, SystemUpdater, DRM) and SharedObject FMS boundary
reviews.summary: Completes all 113 non-SharedObject Partial AS3 Flash Player declarations (Loader SWF audio/video/domainMemory/E4X, Worker threads, SystemUpdater streaming, DRM + AES-128-CTR NetStream) and records the native Adobe RTMP/FMS boundary on SharedObject.getRemote/connect alongside WebSocket relay and offline reconciliation.
